paper_id: Image Generation Network for Covert Transmission in Online Social Network
title: Image Generation Network for Covert Transmission in Online Social Network
motivation: OSN普及使私密信息传递成为可能，但传统隐写因修改载体而留痕易被检测
problem_framing: 用GAN直接合成图像传递秘密信息，而非修改图像像素
key_insight: 用秘密消息控制AdaIN的scale和bias，实现语义层面的信息编码
method_signature: CIS-Net四模块：生成+对抗+噪声模拟+提取
evaluation_criteria: FID衡量视觉质量，提取准确率验证鲁棒性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 网络在高纹理区域产生噪声，直接训练效果不佳；16-bit时random_noise有效，32-bit时几乎失效
evidence_for_taste: the quality of generated images is still the heel of Achilles
the network tends to leave noise in the high-frequency area
we find that the effect of random noise is obvious when the length of secret messages is 16
Since we can not achieve 100% extraction accuracy
new unknown noises may reduce accuracy
thinking_moves: 从实验异常(高频频域噪声)反推预处理失效
把不可微分JPEG处理成constant tensor以实现端到端训练
用retrained模型的多样性解决检测泛化问题
extraction_notes: 研究者slug为xinpeng_zhao，但论文作者为Xinpeng Zhang，可能存在姓名不匹配或提取目标有误的情况
